newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper ends firmer after choppy session.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper ends firmer after choppy session.

text.p: COMEX copper settled slightly firmer ahead of a scheduled mine strike in Chile as LME warehouse stocks continued to fall, traders said.
A small union at Escondida mine voted to strike from 1300 GMT Friday. Management has said output will not be affected.
"People don't want to be short because they don't know about the Escondida situation...It's hard to know what the unions are going to do," Bette Raptopoulos of Prudential Securities said.
May COMEX settled 0.40 cent firmer at 105.55 cents a lb, traded 106.20 to 104.10 cents. Spot April went out 0.05 cent higher at 106.25 cents.
LME reported on Thursday that stocks fell 850 tonnes to 153,825 tonnes.
The LME cash to three months backwardation remained stable at $32/$36.
COMEX stocks on Thursday rose 780 short tons to 46,388 short tons.
